currency.basis: Live official-site asset and current Play listing icon fetched 2026-10-04; the retired standalone 'in' mark is no longer used in official identity surfaces.

identity.basis: The wordmark lockup is declared and rendered by ininal.com as its logo and matches the official Play app icon for the ininal wallet.

assessment.independenceRationale: First-party site assets and the official publisher's Play listing are two independent publication channels confirming the same current design.

variant.basis: Transparent wordmark-plus-bars lockup variant (dark wordmark); presentation/backing decided at candidate preparation.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Wordmark letterforms and the three underline bars survive conversion exactly; both theme renders show sharp, complete details with no lost gaps or rounded corners.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Lockup aspect ratio preserved by uniform scale; placed at 48/54 width with full clearance inside the circle (vertical extent about 18 of 54). At 24/32/48 px diagnostics the wordmark stays readable and the bars remain visible; comparable small-size behavior to the accepted icon.
candidate.rationale: Evidenced rebrand to the current official ininal identity: the wordmark lockup (dark wordmark plus cyan/yellow/red underline bars) is declared as the site logo on ininal.com, used as the favicon, and is the official Google Play app icon; the accepted standalone 'in' mark is the retired previous-generation app icon.
transforms: Working SVG rebuilt from the official logo.svg: the three paths copied unchanged (fills #3cb4e5, #ffc600, #e54360 on the bars, dark charcoal wordmark), class and data-name attributes removed; no geometry edits.
Whole-emblem placement only: uniform scale 0.507292 and translation centering the lockup (viewBox 0 0 94.62 35.71 -> width 48 of 54), no rotation, stretch, crop or redraw.

Catalog backing added: plain white circle r=27 behind the emblem. The source is transparent with no brand field, so the neutral white circle is a catalog presentation adaptation for dark-theme legibility, not an observed official avatar.

SVGO run on a copy with the repository svgo.config.mjs: output grew 1718 -> 2055 bytes, so optimization was skipped and the unoptimized working version was kept as final; both versions render identically.
candidate.variant: Current official wordmark-lockup variant (transparent source: dark charcoal wordmark + three colored bars) on a constructed white circular catalog backing; the wordmark is the brand's entire mark, no accompanying name, slogan or explanatory text.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Accepted icon: retired standalone 'in' app mark (dark rounded square, light-blue glyphs). Final: current official 'ininal' wordmark lockup with colored bars on a white circular field. The change is the evidenced current official identity, clearly different in both themes; not a serialization change.

proposals.reason: Supported rebrand: the current official ininal identity is the 'ininal' wordmark lockup (dark wordmark plus cyan/yellow/red underline bars), used as the official logo.svg on ininal.com (declared by the site's schema.org logo field and rendered in the header/footer), as the official favicon, and as the official Google Play app icon (512px raster). The accepted icon's standalone 'in' mark is the previous-generation app icon and no current standalone mark exists publicly. The wordmark is the brand's entire mark (letters form the mark; no accompanying name, slogan or explanatory text beyond the mark itself), so it is catalog-eligible. Original vector available (official SVG, no raster).

sourceCandidate.rationale: Official original vector of the current wordmark-lockup identity, served from the bank's own domain; pure vector paths, no raster.

sources.independenceGroup: ininal.com first-party site and CDN assets (one publication)
sources.observation: Official ininal.com site declares logo.svg as its schema.org logo and renders the same lockup inline in header/footer. The SVG is the 'ininal' wordmark plus three underline accent bars (#3cb4e5/#ffc600/#e54360), viewBox 0 0 94.62 35.71, dark charcoal wordmark, pure vector paths, no raster, no extra text.

sources.independenceGroup: Google Play listing of the official publisher app (distinct from ininal.com site)
sources.observation: Official Google Play listing icon (512x512, itemprop=image) shows the same wordmark lockup as the current app icon on a dark rounded square; confirms the lockup is the current official identity and the standalone 'in' mark is retired.

sources.independenceGroup: ininal.com first-party site (same publication as the logo source)
sources.observation: Official favicon (32x32 webp served as favicon.png, exact URL from homepage HTML) shows the wordmark lockup on dark background; third first-party confirmation of the current identity.
